summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, disclosing the change of title for Mr. LAM Tai Mau from Financial Controller to Chief Financial Officer, effective June 2, 2026. This appointment follows the prior disclosure on May 15, 2026, of his initial appointment as Financial Controller with CFO scope. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms are mentioned. The filing is a routine officer title change, not a forced departure or broader restructuring. Watch for any subsequent disclosure of CFO resignation or other management transitions.
